description_en: After you apply for SMS qualifications, you can call this operation to query the details of a single qualification
description_zh: 当您在申请短信资质后，可以通过此接口查询单个资质详情
name: QuerySingleSmsQualification

parameters.description_en: The qualification ID, which is the ID returned when you [apply for a qualification](~~SubmitSmsQualification~~). You can call the [QuerySmsQualificationRecord](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~) operation to obtain the qualification IDs under your current account.
parameters.description_zh: 资质ID，即您[申请资质](~~SubmitSmsQualification~~)返回的ID。您可以通过[查询资质列表](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)获取当前账号下的资质ID。
parameters.help_en: The qualification ID, which is the ID returned when you [apply for a qualification](~~SubmitSmsQualification~~). You can call the [QuerySmsQualificationRecord](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~) operation to obtain the qualification IDs under your current account
parameters.help_zh: 资质ID，即您[申请资质](~~SubmitSmsQualification~~)返回的ID。您可以通过[查询资质列表](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)获取当前账号下的资质ID
parameters.name: qualification_group_id

parameters.description_en: The review ticket ID. You can call the [QuerySmsQualificationRecord](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~) operation to obtain the qualifications and corresponding review ticket IDs under your current account.
parameters.description_zh: 审核工单ID，您可以通过[查询资质列表](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)获取当前账号下的资质及其对应审核工单ID。
parameters.help_en: The review ticket ID. You can call the [QuerySmsQualificationRecord](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~) operation to obtain the qualifications and corresponding review ticket IDs under your current account
parameters.help_zh: 审核工单ID，您可以通过[查询资质列表](~~QuerySmsQualificationRecord~~)获取当前账号下的资质及其对应审核工单ID
parameters.name: order_id
